meta.title: 屏東縣115學年度國民中小學學區（Codex 由官方公告整理）
meta.method: 由 Codex 整理之官方學區規則轉入（tools/import_codex.py）；條件式規則保留原文、不拆分。
notes: Official PDF tables are preserved; only unambiguous village/neighborhood clauses are executable.
mode=conditional and requiresReview clauses must never be matched as all.
All matching schools form an option set; admission capacity and eligibility are separate.
Shared rules, exceptional conditions and policy notes are not fully modeled. No nearest-school assignment.
大學區制 headings are retained on schools; eligibility/choice scope requires policy confirmation and is not assumed to mean every school in a township.
